title: Review/Outcome Record (ROR) v0.1
description: A first-class, independently tamper-evident record linked to exactly one Control Evidence Record. Never edits the CER — only appends a related event.

timestamp.description: When the review outcome was reached.

linked_record_id.description: The record_id of the base CER this review pertains to.

linked_record_hash.description: The linked CER's evidence_metadata.record_hash at the time this ROR was created — lets a verifier confirm the base record hasn't drifted between the original action and the review.

outcome_action.description: Populated only if the review changed account/feature state, e.g. access_reinstated.
